summary: Implemented Lambda (vanilla, monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (dictionary, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases, docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py.
